name: Bloody Barber Thief OLD
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #4-07: A Most Wondrous Exchange!

items.name: Composite Shortbow
items.description: This shortbow is made from horn, wood, and sinew laminated together to increase the power of its pull and the force of its projectile. Its compact size and power make it a favorite of mounted archers. Any time an ability is specifically restricted to a shortbow, it also applies to composite shortbows unless otherwise stated.

items.name: Sap
items.description: A sap has a soft wrapping around a dense core, typically a leather sheath around a lead rod. Its head is wider than its grip to disperse the force of a blow, as the weapon's purpose is to knock out its victim rather than to draw blood.

items.name: Shortsword
items.description: These blades come in a variety of shapes and styles, but they are typically 2 feet long.

items.name: Leather Armor
items.description: A mix of flexible and molded boiled leather, a suit of this type of armor provides some protection with maximum flexibility.

items.name: Thieves' Tools
items.description:
You need thieves' tools to Pick Locks or Disable Devices (of some types) using the Thievery skill.

If your thieves' tools are broken, you can repair them by replacing the lock picks with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.Thieves' Toolkit (Replacement Picks)]{Replacement Picks} appropriate to your tools; this doesn't require using the Repair action.

savenote: +1 circumstance to all saves vs. traps

defensiveAbilities.name: +1 Circumstance to All Saves vs. Traps
Deny Advantage
defensiveAbilities.description: The thief isn't off-guard to creatures of 5th level or lower that are Hidden, Undetected, flanking, or using Surprise Attack.

defensiveAbilities.name: Nimble Dodge
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger The thief is targeted with a melee or ranged attack by an attacker it can see.

Effect The thief gains a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack.

offensiveAbilities.name: Mobility
offensiveAbilities.description: When the thief Strides half their speed or less, that movement does not trigger reactions.

offensiveAbilities.name: Sneak Attack
offensiveAbilities.description: The thief deals 1d6 extra precision damage to Off-Guard creatures.

offensiveAbilities.name: Surprise Attack
offensiveAbilities.description: On the first round of combat, if the thief rolls Deception or Stealth for initiative, creatures that haven't acted are Off-Guard to them.
